- Numerous small, scattered reddish-brown/dark spots on the upper leaf surface
- Yellow-orange halos surrounding many of the spots
- General chlorosis/yellowing of the leaf background

**Comparison with candidates:**

- **Septoria_brown_spot**: Reference shows small dark brown lesions on yellowing leaves with adjacent spots coalescing — very close match. The scattered small dark spots with yellow halos in the test image align well.
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: Reference shows larger, more discrete lesions with a gray center and reddish-brown border — the test spots are smaller and lack the gray center.
- **Downy_mildew**: Reference shows diffuse pale yellowing with fungal tufts on undersides — not discrete dark spots like in the test image.
- **Soybean_rust**: Pustules mainly on lower surface; the microscopic view shows round raised pustules distinct from these flat spots.
- **Bacterial_Blight**: Angular, water-soaked lesions — not present here.

The small scattered dark brown lesions with yellow halos on a yellowing leaf are most consistent with **Septoria_brown_spot**.
